verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Statsig serves an llms.txt at docs.statsig.com that returns HTTP 200 and describes the official documentation. Statsig also documents a Docs MCP server that lets AI clients read public documentation directly from /api/mcp, with no API key required. Missing for 10: independent community or hands-on reports of agents actually consuming these docs, and evidence of how complete the llms.txt index is (e.g., a full-text variant).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.statsig.com/llms.txt # Statsig Documentation
Use the Statsig Docs MCP server to let supported AI clients read public Statsig documentation directly from /api/mcp.
The Docs MCP server reads documentation only and needs no API key.
